evidence.claim: Three online authorizations of $100.09, $99.96 and $100.09 within 70 minutes on card C04570-K1, ending with the flagged transaction
All three came from the same device profile, which the card had also used in October, so the device is not new to this account
Customer stated they did not make these purchases and still holds the card

case.summary: Three online authorizations of about $100 each landed on card C04570-K1 within 70 minutes on 2016-11-11, ending with the flagged transaction. All three came from a device profile the card had used before, so the device itself is not new. The cardholder denied the activity when asked. Exposure is $300.14 across the three transactions.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Simulated: customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card

initial.reason: R1: probability below 0.70 on a single-signal velocity pattern, verify before any block

final.reason: R2: customer denied the transactions; exposure $300.14 is at or below $2,500
R2: a denial always opens a case

next_best_actions.what_changed: The customer denied the transactions, which raised the probability and moved the recommendation from verification to a block with a case.

sar.reason: R2: exposure of $300.14 is below the $1,000 threshold and the activity connects to no shared device, region cluster or other customer's fraud, so a case without a report is the correct disposition.

stop_reason: The customer denial settled the verdict and no further evidence could change the action.
